name: kb-excludes-pack-payload
title: Stop copying pack-installed payload into the Obsidian KB
description: `scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-update-spec-kb.py` copies every platform-adapter tree it finds into the consumer's Obsidian KB, without distinguishing content the repository owns from payload this pack installed. The result is the same pack payload duplicated into eight separate vaults. Exclude the installed payload and keep the repository-owned guidance.
creator: sdelmas
